hypotheses.justification: This can be deleted while keeping the other hypotheses. The partition gives V ⊆ U and W ⊆ U, hence sUnion {V,W} ⊆ U. By regular_mono and hU.2, supCode c {V,W} = regular c (sUnion {V,W}) ⊆ regular c U = U. The reverse inclusion uses hU and the covering clause of Partition, not hV. This argument does not depend on V being nonempty or on any special case for the pair {V,W}.
